Title: Azure Stack Edge Pro FPGA is retiring on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
As we recently announced the Azure Stack Edge device/SKU that includes a general purpose nVIDIA GPU, which can support a large set of AI/ML models/SDKs, we are retiring the Azure Stack Edge FPGA SKU on 29 February 2024. We encourage you to make the switch early to take advantage of the rich benefits in Azure Stack Edge Pro GPU.  

Action required 

After 29 February 2024, the following will no longer be available for Azure Stack Edge Pro FPGA devices 

  • Replacement devices.  
  • Security patches and critical updates.  
  • Customer support resources (phone, email, web). 

Start your transition to the Azure Stack Edge Pro GPU before 29 February 2024. Prepare by backing up from the FPGA device and creating a new Azure Stack Edge Pro GPU order.  

More information  

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A  If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
